parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable

Overview

Mangaka is a Secret Limited unit. He was only obtainable by clearing stage 4 or 5 of the Bizarre Town raid with a 1% and 3% chance respectively.

Evolving

Mangaka can evolve into Mangaka (Artist) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Mangaka
x1 Reality Pen
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x2 Star Fruit (Red)
x2 Star Fruit (Pink)
x3 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Mangaka (Artist)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
